P	A few minutes from Stonetop, near the base of the bluff, in the <b>Great Wood</b> (page 200). Wide, shallow, swift, lined with small stones. Folks come here to wash and fetch water, but rarely alone. It's not deep, but it's still a body of water.
B	The current's constant rush and murmur
B	Flat plain on either side, gravelly, dotted with saplings, weeds, wildflowers
B	Vague sense of dread, of being watched
B	<b>Spring</b>: cold snowmelt swelling
B	<b>Summer</b>: dragonflies, lightning bugs
B	<b>Spring/Autumn</b>: leaves in current
B	<b>Winter</b>: eerie stillness, icy surface Tip: raise your voice a little, like you're talking over background sound

H2	Hooks
HR
B	A dangerous beast takes to watering near town.
B	The Stream runs dry, despite ample rains
B	Something mysterious (dangerous?) is deposited by the current.
